name: Allen & Heath SQ
notes: TypeScript module for SQ-5, SQ-6 and SQ-7 (config model dropdown, src/mixer/models.ts) over the Allen & Heath MIDI protocol (TCP). All 45 actions of src/actions/actions.ts (getActions) and all 11 feedbacks of src/feedbacks/ are catalogued; the module has no per-model difference in action ids.

The strip counts are the same for all three models: 48 input channels, 12 mixes, 12 groups, 8 FX returns, 4 FX sends, 3 matrices, 8 DCAs, 8 mute groups; only the soft key count (8 on SQ-5, 16 on SQ-6 and SQ-7) differs, so the soft key option states the maximum of 16 (the largest) and the description names the per-model limit. 300 scenes on all models.

Strip selection options are number fields (min 1, max = count, 1-based). Mix selections (source or sink) are dropdowns whose first entry has the id "LR" and whose other entries are the numbers 1..12 with the labels "MIX 1".."MIX 12"; the multi-selection of mix sinks adds "LR" the same way (src/choices.ts).

The level dropdown (90 entries) and the pan/balance dropdown (43 entries) are not listed because of their length; choicesNote documents the id scheme. Both and the fade dropdown set disableAutoExpression, so they cannot be driven by an expression.
The two actions fxrlev_to_grp and fxrpan_to_grp are gutted: they only show a static text and log a warning when run (they exist so that old configurations still load).
mute_aux is the action id for mixes (the label is "Mute Mix"); the feedbacks mute_* reuse the same ids as the mute actions.

Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3 (2.x): option values support expressions except where disableAutoExpression is set; the module documents expression formats in expressionDescription (for example "an integer between 1 and 48").
Not catalogued: config fields, variables, presets and the upgrade scripts.

actions.name: Press Softkey
actions.description: The maximum of the soft key number is the number of soft keys of the selected model: 8 on the SQ-5, 16 on the SQ-6 and SQ-7 (src/mixer/models.ts).

actions.name: Assign FX return to FX send

options.label: Level
options.choicesNote: 90 choices (src/actions/fading.ts LevelOption): 1000 = "Last dB value" (accepted but does nothing in the callback), the step values "step+0.1", "step+1", "step+3", "step+6", "step-0.1", "step-1", "step-3", "step-6" (relative fades), "-inf" (label "-∞ dB"), -85 to -40 dB in steps of 5, -39 to -10 dB in steps of 1, and -9.5 to +10 dB in steps of 0.5; numeric ids are numbers
